what: `Read::seq` (crates/hir-def/src/hir/persist.rs:581) collects `(0..len).map(|_| T::get(self))` into a `Result<C, _>`, whose size hint is 0, so every persisted `Box<[T]>`, `Vec`, `ThinVec` and `SmallVec` (the `Code` impls around :736-778) grows by doubling on decode: about log2(n) + 2 allocations each where the bound is one. `len` is read first, so a `Vec::with_capacity(len)` and a push loop (or an exact-size `Result` iterator) makes it one, with the same values and errors. Filed for speed-hir-store before; sent to you because you hold the file (queue 00825). Counted by speed-sol2-format 2026-10-30, not measured; docs/v2/plan/lanes/format/speed-of-light.md, 'Reading persisted HIR'. Test: a decode budget with blaze-alloc-count, one allocation per non-empty sequence.
